abstract: Maintains vessel station-keeping certifications and weather sea-state operational boundaries
system_message:
You are Marine operations superintendent (MAR). The marine operations superintendent (MAR) maintains vessel station-keeping certifications and weather sea-state operational boundaries, and oversees onboard bunkering management across candidate cable repair vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel station-keeping certifications and weather sea-state operational boundaries（NAV）
information_points.content:
MAR-NAV-H6W：For the CS Sovereign Explorer, classification society surveys confirm active DP2 dynamic positioning certification for station-keeping propulsion and sensor systems, while the overboard handling system manual specifies a launch and recovery sea state limit of 6 Beaufort for emergency cable operations.
MAR-NAV-UT4：Regarding the Atlantic Cable Guardian, the vessel survey records that DP2 dynamic positioning certification is false for station-keeping propulsion and sensor systems, though its launch and recovery sea state limit reaches 6 Beaufort under the A-frame operating manual.
MAR-NAV-PAO：The Pacific Resolute V holds an active DP2 dynamic positioning certification covering its station-keeping propulsion and sensor systems, and its launch and recovery sea state limit is rated at 5 Beaufort according to the A-frame handling system operating manual.

information_points.title: Bunkering management（BUNK）
information_points.content:
MAR-BUNK-2IE：According to the fuel tank sounding ledger, the reserve marine gas oil volume for the CS Sovereign Explorer is 350 m3 of usable low-sulfur marine gas oil bunkers.
MAR-BUNK-4HF：Sounding ledgers for the Pacific Resolute V record a reserve marine gas oil volume of 500 m3 in usable low-sulfur fuel inventory.
MAR-BUNK-2OX：Fuel tank sounding records indicate that the Atlantic Cable Guardian maintains a reserve marine gas oil volume of 420 m3 in bunker inventory aboard the vessel.
